services.desc: If your time is limited the shorter trip will provide you with an exciting sport fishing adventure that will fit into your schedule! The longer trips can experience the most tide changes and allow Capt. Borges to fish the greatest area of the Kona waters to maximize your catching potential! Trips usually depart at 6:30 am. However, depending on fishing conditions, an earlier departure may be recommended to optimize your fishing experience. Please coordinate directly with Capt. blurb: Born and raised in Kona, Captain David Borges Jr. has spent his life fishing the waters of Hawaiʻi and pursuing big-game fish around the world, including Australia’s Great Barrier Reef and Madeira. David has captained the Kona Dream since 2020, combining local knowledge, international experience, and a competitive drive to consistently put anglers on fish.
